A Beginner’s Guide to Whiskey Flavor Profiles

by Irma Wallace | Sep 24, 2026 | Food & Drink Infographics

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Choosing whiskey can be easier when you understand the different flavor profiles. This infographic from Royal Spirit Al Ain provides a simple visual guide to five common whiskey styles: light & smooth, fruity, sweet, rich, and smoky. It is designed to help beginners understand common tasting characteristics and discover which whiskey profile may suit their preferences.
